subject: E-Commerce
title: Mercado Libre: Latin America's Amazon
description: One-minute skill: Mercado Libre: Latin America's Amazon.

hook.text: Mercado Libre is worth $80 billion and dominates e-commerce across 18 Latin American countries. Amazon struggles there.

buildup.text: Founded in Argentina in 1999, Mercado Libre understood local challenges: poor logistics, limited banking, cash culture.

discovery.text: Mercado Pago, its payment arm, serves 40 million users. It solved the unbanked problem before Amazon even entered.

twist.text: Amazon launched in Brazil but trails Mercado Libre significantly. Local knowledge beats global brand power in LatAm.

climax.text: Mercado Libre proves that regional champions who solve local problems can outcompete global giants.

punchline.text: $80 billion, 18 countries. Latin America's e-commerce king built for local.

quiz.question: Why does Mercado Libre outperform Amazon in Latin America?
options: It solved local challenges like limited banking and poor logistics first
